- **FitHub:** The user’s note says they have not gone since moving in April; $49.99 monthly charges continued through October 15. I saved a waiting case requesting approval to cancel.
- **CloudBox:** The user says the service is no longer needed. The $59.99 annual renewal posted October 1; the stated 14-day refund window ended October 15. I saved a waiting case requesting approval to cancel. Any refund request would need to ask for an exception.
- **ShopMart return:** The promised $43.53 refund posted September 12. I confirmed it in the transactions. The result tool could not attach it to a work item because the referenced work record was not found.
- The other recurring leads are Spotify ($11.99/month), Metro Power (variable, last charge $91.58), and Oakview rent ($1,625/month). I found no source saying these are unwanted or need a support request.

No authorized company request was submitted because browser actions were blocked by the workspace’s human controller. The two cancellation approvals are saved as waiting cases.
